name: Yuni
source:
Discovered as a savant in an unusual way, hence why he's called a "miracle."  He was given special treatment at the European Headquarters and did not join the mission, but he was suddenly transferred to the Far East Branch..

He hates troublesome and painful things, but loves women. He can't sleep until he feels another person's skin.

He pities Manna, a junior savant, and thinks that he'd be useless without him.

[Translated and edited from [url=http://b-cluster.eek.jp/raid/character_detail.html#unity]official website[/url]]
